Prior review retained below:
Re-read the exact questionnaire and challenged literal scope, agreement direction, source support and implementation dates. Corrected private currency from neutral to agree after checking the operative stablecoin framework, and school teaching from neutral to agree because teaching about protected groups does not require endorsing disputed claims. Strengthened drug, interception, seat-belt, religious-dress, holidays, tax-devolution and emergency citations. Withdrew five Culture/Nature answers rather than use neutral for unknown evidence. Explicit national-community analogies at assimilation Q6 and central Q13, invasive-implant analogies at innovation Q8/Q11, and educational inferences at Culture/Nature Q7/Q13/Q15 warrant independent reviewer scrutiny. Domain-specific NHS mixed models support stress, attention, phobia and temperament neutrality. Cross-checked government claims against Reuters, AP, Freedom House, Human Rights Watch, IfG and IFS, whose distinct publishers are not counted as extra government departments. Reviewed counterevidence including Lords Spiritual, Commons sovereignty, protest restrictions, conditional refugee status, NHS private provision, and retained private businesses. Burnham care/water/electoral proposals, 2028 fiscal devolution and uncommenced abortion changes are not treated as completed. Commons flag File page creator and public-domain terms checked; local 960x576 PNG visually inspected. Shared credits, independent review, archive, generation and browser checks remain for integration. No similarity neighbours were reported in draft validation. Focused continuation on 2026-10-05 by primary OpenAI Codex agent /root: Read the accessible PDF of Genomics Beyond Health, including its education discussion (pp.134–141); it explicitly states that it is not government policy. It concerns individual cognitive/educational traits, not national IQ or general interests. Targeted official-source searches located empathy genetics research and prosecutorial brain-maturation guidance, without establishing adoption of the required comparative explanation. Maturation is not inherited variation. Equality obligations and sex verification do not rank causes of general male–female behaviour. No adopted ranking for immediate moral intuition was located. The early-years HTML source was intermittently unavailable and no successful complete reread is claimed. All 5 exact question-level gaps remain null/unknown. Existing supported answers, period and cutoff are preserved. This was a focused same-agent research and separate challenge pass, not a complete independent re-review or publication sign-off. Separate completion pass on 2026-10-05: checked the 5 new educated assumptions against exact question wording, agreement direction, contextual sources and prior withdrawal reasons. These are most-likely provisional estimates, not adopted national causal theories. The distinction between individual and national/racial heredity, immediate intuition and deliberate instruction, and interventions and causal predominance is retained. Assumption IDs: culture-nature-02, culture-nature-03, culture-nature-05, culture-nature-08, culture-nature-10. Reviewed neutral-heavy axis rationales: explicit mixed institutions, competing implemented rules and interaction models justify retained neutral choices; uncertainty alone was not used as the neutral rationale. Earlier whole-assessment review is preserved; this continuation does not claim a fresh independent 240-source reread or a human review. Similarity and browser checks are recorded separately after integration.
